title: Guided knowledge base setup
description:
A guided knowledge base setup workflow in Jira Service Management helps admins connect Confluence or supported third-party sources, check permissions and plan eligibility, and complete authorization. It also separates basic Rovo eligibility for third-party connectors from the Rovo-powered Create with Rovo path. To set up a knowledge base source: Review the permission guidance shown for the source path.
